The Happy Hound

★★★★★ 4.6
📍 Los Gatos, California📅 2026
American Hot Dog Burger
The Happy Hound is a total local legend in Los Gatos, a town on the southern edge of Silicon Valley. They’ve been serving up goodness from their standalone spot on Los Gatos Blvd since 1971, and you can’t miss their logo—a bright yellow hound rocking a chef’s hat. Their specialty is "Old Fashioned Hot Dogs & Hamburgers," featuring nostalgic dogs and made-to-order burgers. You can grab your meal at the counter and find a spot in the garden seating next door, or just order online for a quick takeaway. Every dog here is 100% beef, and if you like yours with a bit of a char, just ask them to throw it on the grill. Pro tip: you can double up with an extra sausage in the same bun for just $3. The classic "Happy Hound" comes loaded with yellow mustard, relish, onions, and tomatoes; it’s the perfect baseline combo where the sweet-and-sour relish beautifully cuts through the savory beef. For the ultimate American comfort food experience, try the "Chili Cheese Hound," smothered in chili meat sauce, shredded cheddar, and onions until the cheese melts into everything. If you’re feeling extra hungry, the "Polish Hound" swaps the dog for a thick Polish sausage on French bread; it’s much meatier and heartier than your average dog. We took three to go and sliced them up to share, and the buns held up surprisingly well even after soaking up all that sauce. The menu also features the "Kraut Hound" with sauerkraut, a tortilla-wrapped "Mexi-Hound," and the fiery "Hell Hound" loaded with bacon, jalapeños, and "Angry Sauce," plus corn dogs and veggie options. The burger side ranges from the simple Happy Burger to double-patties and turkey burgers, with sides like fries, tater tots, onion rings, and chili cheese cups. To wash it all down, they’ve got old-school shakes, malts, and ice cream floats. Perfect for family outings, parents with kids, or a quick solo lunch or dinner.
